title: DoD IG Releases Heavily Redacted UAP Whistleblower Reprisal Report
description: The Department of Defense Inspector General published its final report on UAP-related whistleblower reprisal complaints, confirming investigations into security clearance revocation as retaliation. Heavy redactions fueled further transparency demands.

title: James Fox Hosts Landmark UAP Press Conference at National Press Club
description: Filmmaker James Fox convened witnesses, medical experts, and government insiders at the National Press Club to present new evidence of alleged non-human encounters and crash-retrieval programs.

title: Trump Orders Declassification of All Government UAP Files
description: President Trump signed an executive order directing the Pentagon and all relevant agencies to begin identifying and releasing government files related to UAP, alien life, and extraterrestrial materials.

title: Hegseth Reaffirms UAP Disclosure Commitment
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth doubled down on Trump's promise of UAP transparency as AARO's caseload surpassed 2,000 reports.

title: AARO Reaches Full Operational Capability
description: The All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office achieved full operational capability, completing its organizational buildout and establishing permanent analytical, collection, and reporting infrastructure.

title: Sol Foundation Symposium Convenes in Italy
description: The Sol Foundation, founded by Stanford's Garry Nolan, held its 2025 symposium at Lake Maggiore in Italy — bringing together scientists, former officials, and policy experts for one of the year's most significant UAP academic gatherings.

title: House Task Force Hearing: UAP Transparency and Whistleblower Protection
description: The House Oversight Committee's Task Force on Declassification held its third public UAP hearing, featuring military whistleblowers presenting new evidence and testimony on alleged government concealment.

title: 'The Age of Disclosure' Documentary Released on Prime Video
description: Feature-length documentary featuring active and retired military personnel revealing firsthand accounts of UAP activity, including encounters at Vandenberg Space Force Base and alleged Russian craft recovery.

title: FY2026 NDAA Mandates UAP Briefings
description: Congress enacted legislation requiring the Pentagon to brief lawmakers on the number, location, and nature of UAP intercepts by NORTHCOM and NORAD.

title: FAA Formalizes UAP Reporting Procedures for Air Traffic Control
description: The FAA issued updated notices requiring all ATC personnel to report UAP sightings through standardized channels and notify AARO directly.

title: NARA Deadline: Agencies Required to Transfer UAP Records
description: Deadline for all federal agencies to transfer UAP records to National Archives per 2024 NDAA. ODNI, OSD, FAA, and NRC complied; FBI, CIA, and most DoD sub-agencies did not meet the deadline.

title: AARO Hosts Civilian Researcher Workshop
description: First formal workshop bringing together government, academic, and civilian researchers to standardize UAP data collection and analysis.

title: AARO Caseload Exceeds 2,000 Reports
description: AARO's total UAP caseload officially passed the 2,000-report milestone, with approximately 1,000 reports lacking sufficient data for resolution held in an Active Archive.

title: National Archives Releases First Batch of UAP Records
description: NARA published the first UAP records from Record Group 615, including materials from ODNI, Office of the Secretary of Defense, FAA, and NRC. Bulk download portal made available.

title: UAP Whistleblower Protection Act (H.R. 5060) Introduced
description: Reps. Burchett and Luna introduced bipartisan legislation to codify federal protections for UAP whistleblowers, explicitly prohibiting security clearance revocation as retaliation.

title: SCU Conference in Huntsville Features Former DIA UAPTF Director
description: The Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies held its annual conference in Huntsville, Alabama, featuring a keynote by Jay Stratton — retired DIA official and first director of the UAP Task Force.

title: Burlison Introduces UAP Disclosure Act of 2025 as NDAA Amendment
description: Rep. Eric Burlison submitted the UAP Disclosure Act of 2025 as an amendment to the FY2026 NDAA to increase transparency on government UAP records.

title: UAP Transparency Act (H.R. 1187) Introduced
description: Bipartisan bill requiring declassification of all government UAP documents within 270 days of enactment, with quarterly progress reports to Congress.

title: House Oversight Hearing: 'Exposing the Truth'
description: Second major House hearing on UAPs, featuring military and government witnesses testifying on encounters and alleged cover-ups.

title: AARO Unveils FY2024 Annual Report — 757 New Reports
description: ODNI/AARO annual report covering 757 UAP reports received May 2023–June 2024. Resolved 118 cases; 21 remained truly unexplained. Total caseload reached 1,652.

title: NRC Transfers UAP Records to National Archives
description: Nuclear Regulatory Commission became one of the first agencies to comply with the NDAA mandate, transferring all UAP-related records to NARA.

title: National Archives Creates Record Group 615
description: NARA established a dedicated record group for UAP-related documents, enabling federal agencies to transfer historical records for permanent public access.

title: DOE/NNSA Releases UAP Documents on Nuclear Site Incursions
description: Department of Energy released documents detailing unexplained aerial incursions near nuclear weapons facilities including Pantex and Lawrence Livermore.

title: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. 1 Released
description: Comprehensive review of U.S. government UAP involvement from 1945–2023. Found no evidence of extraterrestrial technology but acknowledged gaps in record-keeping.

title: NASA Releases UAP Study, Appoints Director of UAP Research
description: NASA published its independent study team report on UAPs and appointed a Director of UAP Research to establish an institutional science program for data collection and analysis.

title: Schumer-Rounds UAP Disclosure Act Filed
description: Bipartisan amendment modeled on JFK Assassination Records Act mandating presumption of disclosure for UAP records with 25-year declassification timeline.

title: Landmark House Hearing: Grusch, Graves, Fravor Testify
description: David Grusch alleged the government possesses non-human craft and biologics. Navy pilots Ryan Graves and David Fravor described firsthand UAP encounters. Watched by millions worldwide.

title: Senate Armed Services Hearing on AARO Mission
description: AARO Director Dr. Sean Kirkpatrick testified on the office's mission, case resolution methodology, and budget before the Senate Armed Services Subcommittee.

title: AARO Officially Established
description: The All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) was created within the Department of Defense to investigate UAPs, replacing the earlier AOIMSG.

title: First Public Congressional UFO Hearing in 50+ Years
description: House Intelligence Subcommittee held the first open congressional hearing on UFOs since 1969. Pentagon officials acknowledged encounters and committed to transparency.

title: DNI Preliminary Assessment: UAP Report
description: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence released the landmark preliminary assessment of UAPs, acknowledging 144 reports from military personnel and resolving only one.

title: Intelligence Authorization Act Mandates UAP Task Force Report
description: Congress required the DNI to produce an unclassified report on UAPs within 180 days, setting the stage for the June 2021 preliminary assessment.

title: Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force (UAPTF) Created
description: The Department of Defense formally established the UAPTF within the Department of the Navy to investigate UAP encounters reported by military personnel.

title: Pentagon Officially Releases Three UAP Videos
description: The DOD formally released the FLIR1, Gimbal, and GoFast videos showing Navy encounters with unidentified objects. The videos had previously leaked in 2017.

title: New York Times Reveals Pentagon's Secret UAP Program (AATIP)
description: Groundbreaking NYT investigation revealed the existence of the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP), a $22 million Pentagon program to study UAPs. The story changed the public conversation.

title: USS Nimitz 'Tic Tac' Encounter
description: Commander David Fravor and other Navy pilots encountered a white, 40-foot 'Tic Tac' shaped object over the Pacific exhibiting unexplained acceleration. Later became one of the most studied UAP cases in history.
